author: Play On Tabletop
description:
Thank you Front Line Gaming for sponsoring this episode.  Matts, terrain, gaming accessories you name it they got it.  Tickets are available for the Las Vegas Open, one of the largest 40k tournaments in the world on October 1st to 4th.  Also this year, Gundam Assemble, KOTC and more are running events.  It's sure to be a blast. 
https://www.lasvegasopen.net

===============GAME INFO=============

Jt is in the house to show everyone that he is the biggest baddest warboss this side of Gork's Grin.  He's brought a Killy 'ard list that is ready to take any and all.  Steve is ready to answer him!  Piloting the Blood Ravens is a hobby dram come true for this Space Marine aficionado and hes does NOT want to let everyone down.  This should be good!

Special thanks to Matthew the owner of this army for lending it to us and to rattlecanstudios.com for sending it on!

===============ARMY LIST=============
Orks
Recon
Kult of Speed Bully Boyz Brute Bosses

Attached unit 1
